admin.access-help: Everybody admitted to the product can be given a role on this engagement. A role here decides what they may do, and nothing else does.
admin.delete-engagement-warning: Deleting an engagement removes its connections, its runs and everything they found. It cannot be undone.
admin.engagements-lede: One engagement per client. Everything else in the product hangs off the one you are working on.
admin.everybody-already-here: Everybody admitted to the product already has a role on this engagement.
admin.nobody-on-this-engagement: Nobody has been given a role on this engagement yet.
app.name: Solution Analyzer
app.tagline: What is in your Power Platform estate, how much of it is debt, and what it would cost to fix.
backlog.approve.explain: Approving records your name against this exact backlog. Publishing anything else afterwards is refused.
backlog.dryRun.explain: Produces exactly what would be created, without calling Azure DevOps.
backlog.no-criteria: No acceptance criteria were written for this item.
backlog.nothing-published-yet: Nothing here has been published. Publishing is a separate act, behind an approval bound to this exact backlog.
backlog.publish.confirmCount: This will create {0} work items in {1}. Confirm the count.
common.name: Name
connections.never-verified: Nothing here has been checked against a real instance. Every claim comes from vendor documentation.
connections.not-built-yet-detail: The capability contract for this platform is written and the reader is not. A run against it reports a missing reader rather than an empty estate.
connections.reach-decides-what-runs: What a mode cannot reach is not a check that passed. Every rule needing evidence this connection has no access to is named in the report as not assessed.
connections.saved-detail: It is ready to use on a run. Nothing has been read from it yet.
connections.secrets-go-to-the-vault-deta: Nothing secret is written to the database. The connection holds a reference and the value stays in the vault.
connections.what-it-is-called-here: What this connection is called in this product. Only you see it.
connections.which-system-help: Pick the platform this connection reads. What the product can see depends on it, and the differences are listed with each one.
connections.you-will-be-sent-to-microsof: You will be sent to Microsoft to sign in to this environment. The product reads it as you.
docs.connecting-summary: The three ways in, and honestly how much each one reaches.
docs.estimates-summary: Where a number comes from, how the backlog is grouped, and what approval binds to.
docs.findings-summary: Categories, severity, evidence, and why severity is not priority.
docs.getting-access-summary: Signing in, being admitted, and the three roles on an engagement.
docs.heading: Documentation
docs.languages-summary: Three language settings, the theme, and what an administrator can see.
docs.lede: Written for a consultant who has never touched Azure. It ships with the product, so it cannot go stale against it.
docs.reports-summary: The workbook, the PDF, and which language each comes out in.
docs.running-summary: The four run modes, the eight stages, and what to read first when it finishes.
docs.search-hint: Searches every guide, not just their titles.
docs.what-this-is-summary: What the product answers, what it refuses to do, and what "not assessed" means.
estimate.confidence.low: Low confidence. Look at the component before planning with this number.
estimate.override.rationaleRequired: Say why. An override with no reason is indistinguishable from a typo three months later.
estimate.override.survives-rerun: This survives a re-extraction and applies to the same finding on the next run.
evidence.explain: What was actually found, so you can check the claim rather than take it.
evidence.heading: Evidence
field.clientId.hint: From the app registration added to the environment as an application user.
field.declaredEnvironmentName.hint: Recorded on the report, because a file cannot say where it was exported from.
field.environmentUrl.hint: The address you open the environment on, without a trailing path.
field.exportedOnUtc.hint: How old the evidence is. A report reads differently against a six month old export.
field.tenantId.hint: The Entra directory the environment belongs to.
field.uploadedFile.hint: An unmanaged solution exported from the environment, as a .zip.
findings.not-assessed-explain: None of these is reported as passing. A short findings list is not the same thing as a clean estate.
health.checking: Checking every part of the system.
health.could-not-read: The system health could not be read.
health.every-check-does-the-thing: Every check does the thing rather than reading a setting that says it could. A connection string naming a database proves nothing; reading a row from it proves three.
health.only-a-global-administrator: Only a global administrator can see this
health.only-a-global-administrator-detai: The health page names servers, vaults and identities, which is more than an engagement role is entitled to.
health.paste-the-key-from-syncfusion: Paste the key from the Syncfusion account
health.the-key-is-stored-in-key-vault: The key is stored in Key Vault and never in the database. Replacing it here takes effect without a restart.
health.this-key-does-not-cover-pdf: This key does not cover document processing, so the PDF will still be watermarked.
modernisation.leaveItAlone: The case for leaving it alone
overview.hours: hours, as a range. There is no single figure and nowhere to put one.
overview.nothing-discovered-lede: Connect a source and run a discovery. Until then there is nothing here, which is different from an estate with nothing in it.
page.administration: Engagements, the people on them, and who may do what.
page.backlog: The work items, before anybody publishes anything.
page.connections: How this engagement reads the client's environment.
page.documentation: Written for a consultant who has never touched Azure. It ships with the product, so it cannot go stale against it.
page.findings: Every finding, its evidence and what it would cost.
page.overview: What is in this estate and how much of it is debt.
page.plan: The plan is what a consultant works from: every finding, what it would take to put right, and the order to do it in.
page.runs: Every analysis, what it reached and what it could not.
page.support: What to do when something is wrong, and whether the deployment itself is the problem.
people.admitting-is-not-granting-detail: Admitting somebody lets them sign in and see nothing. Give them a role on an engagement before they can do any work.
people.lede: Who may sign in, and who may admit others. Being admitted here is not access to an engagement: that is given per engagement.
people.remove-warning: Removing somebody takes away their sign-in and every role they hold. Their name stays on anything they approved.
reports.heading: Reports
reports.inventory-detail: One sheet per thing a consultant filters on: findings with their evidence and estimate, the component inventory with its complexity rating, the customisation profile and the backlog. Produced in process and needing no licence.
reports.inventory-summary: Every finding, every component and the estimate behind each one.
reports.no-pdf-detail: No Syncfusion licence key is configured, and without one every page carries a trial watermark. The workbook is unaffected.
reports.nothing-to-report-lede: A report is produced from a discovery that reached scoring. Run one first.
reports.pdf-detail: Written for somebody who will not open a spreadsheet. It carries the score, the findings that matter and the roadmap, and it names every check that could not run rather than leaving a short list to speak for itself. The written sections print their prompt until somebody types them.
reports.pdf-summary: The document a client reads, with what could not be checked said in it.
run.notAssessed.explain: {0} rules could not run because this connection cannot reach {1}. They are not reported as passing.
runs.nothing-recorded: Nothing was recorded for this run.
runs.writes-nothing: A discovery writes nothing to the environment it reads. There is no setting that changes that.
score.ratio.explain: Counts low code, pro code and external components. Configuration is shown separately and is not in the ratio.
shell.api-unavailable: The product cannot reach its own API.
shell.ask-a-global-administrator-to-add: Ask a global administrator to admit you.
shell.no-access: You are signed in but have not been given access to anything yet. Somebody with an account here has to admit you first.
shell.no-access-title: Your account has no access yet
shell.pick-an-engagement-first: Pick an engagement to open this.
shell.your-microsoft-sign-in-succeeded-b: Your Microsoft sign-in worked. You have not been admitted to anything in this product yet.
step.current: This is the next thing to do.
support.created-by: Created by Peter Ruiter, Principal Solution Architect & CTO Dynamics 365 CX, Capgemini Netherlands
support.lede: Most questions are answered by the documentation, which ships with the product. For the rest, there is a person.
